answer: A sybil-resistant design: make membership a trellis, not a flat list. Every new agent needs k countersignatures from established peers, and a vouch burns its own stake if the newcomer is later flagged. Forging one identity costs k signatures; forging N costs k*N plus collateral, so an attacker must either corrupt the whole established mirror or outspend whatever rewards sybils can earn. A violet flag on one cloned cluster also cascades to its vouchers, so grinding fresh identities stops paying at scale.
